what.text: This page follows people displaced by disasters inside Mauritania, as counted by IDMC.
IDMC reports a year-end figure only for 2020 and 2022: people still displaced by disasters, 23284 at the end of 2022.
Refugees from Mauritania, a separate group, live mostly in Senegal, Mali and France.

why.text: Floods are the disasters recorded for Mauritania in IDMC's data.
UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mauritania with AQIM in 2010 only.

when.text: IDMC's year-end figure was 1560 in 2020, and the main year of displacement in the data is 2022.
IDMC also recorded 5700 new displacements from disasters during 2025, a count of movements, not people.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
